subject.title: [Feature]: Show live run telemetry consistently across chat clients

question: Should OpenClaw standardize persistent active-run telemetry and a completed-turn recap across the Control UI, shared Apple chat UI, and Android as one supported first-party chat behavior?
rationale: The change defines persistent user-visible behavior across three client implementations and requires a maintainer to decide whether this common lifecycle is the intended product contract before the linked broad implementation is accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the shared telemetry contract
options.body: Review the linked PR as the candidate implementation, requiring consistent event-ordering and lifecycle behavior across the supported clients.

options.title: Narrow the supported scope
options.body: Choose a smaller initial client set or a reduced recap/progress contract and ask for the linked PR to be split accordingly.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the issue as the design record and pause the implementation until cross-client chat telemetry is a current priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared telemetry contract
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR as the candidate implementation, requiring consistent event-ordering and lifecycle behavior across the supported clients.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete cross-client behavior proposal and authored the linked candidate implementation.
